posts.title: See You at the 2026 US LLVM Developers' Meeting
posts.description: My first LLVM Dev Meeting (October 26-28, Santa Clara). I will present a poster on the per-pass empirical study of the LLVM optimization pipeline, look forward to participating in the MLIR round table, and will attend part of the MLIR Meetup. Come say hi!

posts.title: Inside a linalg.matmul: A Deep Dive into IREE's Compilation Pipeline
posts.description: A step-by-step walk through the IREE compilation pipeline for a 500x500 f32 matmul on Apple M4: from linalg.matmul to dispatch regions, data tiling, vectorization, LLVM, an ELF library and the virtual machine module, following the real IR dump pass by pass.

posts.title: A Multi-Dimensional, Per-Pass Empirical Study of the LLVM Optimization Pipeline
posts.description: We ran every cumulative prefix of the LLVM -O3 pipeline on 30 PolyBench/C kernels (84,750 measurements). The pipeline is non-monotone (36% of significant changes are slowdowns) and back-loaded, and most of the speedup comes from a small core of passes. A per-pass look at runtime, binary size, hardware counters, and energy.
